tagFilter.emptyDescription: Tags help you filter your hosts. You can add a tag when editing a host.
tagFilter.deleteTagBody_one: This will remove the tag from {{count}} host. The hosts themselves won't be deleted.
tagFilter.deleteTagBody_other: This will remove the tag from {{count}} hosts. The hosts themselves won't be deleted.

vaultUnavailable.note: The vault could not be read, so stored secrets are not shown here. Leave a field empty to keep what is saved; typing a new value replaces it.

vaultBackups.title: Vault backups
vaultBackups.description: Vault files set aside when they could not be opened. Restoring one puts it back as your vault and keeps the current one as a new backup — nothing is deleted.
vaultBackups.empty: No vault backups on this device.
vaultBackups.warn: This backup becomes your vault. It opens with the master password that was in use when it was made, so you will be signed out and asked to unlock.
vaultBackups.warnReadable: Your current vault can be read. Restoring replaces it — it is kept as a new backup, and you will be signed out and asked to unlock with the password that made the restored file.
vaultBackups.restoredToast: Backup restored. Your previous vault was kept as {{file}}.
